video_title: Media Availability: Head Coach Brian Keefe, Trae Young, and Kyshawn George | 11.4.26

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on the Wizards' slow start and defensive lapses
quotes.excerpt: we couldn't overcome our start.
quotes.quote: I have to give them credit, they came out with great pace to start the game. They obviously made some tough shots, even some contested ones early. The second-chance points and some of the loose ball ones were probably the ones that hurt us more. I thought we tried to make a good run there to start the third, we turned them over, our defense ramped it up, but we couldn't overcome our start.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe on the Wizards slow start against the Hawks: I thought we tried to make a good run there to start the third, we turned them over, our defense ramped it up, but we couldn't overcome our start.

structured.context: Head coach Brian Keefe discusses the team's slow start and defensive lapses against their opponent.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on the team's rebounding adjustments
quotes.excerpt: there were some 50-50 battles that they won early in the game.
quotes.quote: I thought we had been done the last two games terrific rebounding. You could see the adjustments we made. They were a lot of threes taken by them tonight, there were some 50-50 battles that they won early in the game. I thought we cleaned a little bit up there in the second, third quarter, but like I said, the margin was too much to overcome.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe on rebounding struggles: They were a lot of threes taken by them tonight, there were some 50-50 battles that they won early in the game. I thought we cleaned a little bit up there in the second, third quarter.

quotes.quote: He's been terrific on both ends, not just his scoring. Obviously, we need his scoring punch, but I think his defense has been terrific, his playmaking. He's had a good start to the season.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on defensive rebounding and second-chance points
quotes.excerpt: we were the number one defensive rebounding team the last two games.
quotes.quote: I think we had made a good adjustment. In the last two games, if you've watched us, we were the number one defensive rebounding team the last two games. Give them credit, this is kind of one of the things that they do. We'll take a look at the film and we'll get better tomorrow.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on team resilience and discipline
quotes.excerpt: I like the resilience of our group.
quotes.quote: I like the resilience of our group first of all. I think Will had an open three in transition that would have cut it to one. He gave us some nice punch tonight too, coming off the bench, and he gave us some really positive energy out there. I like the resiliency, but a lot of times the starts matter. If you give up a lot of points in the first half, that's sometimes tough to overcome.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe on team resilience: I like the resiliency, but a lot of times the starts matter. If you give up a lot of points in the first half, that's sometimes tough to overcome.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on the bench's contribution and rotation
quotes.excerpt: we're playing with different combinations, different groups.
quotes.quote: Early in the season, we're playing with different combinations, different groups. I have great faith in our guys. We got a lot of guys who can who have contributed to a lot of our wins this year. We've had a lot of different contributions in different lineups and different combinations. Guys have stepped up. So, still early in the season, we're still figuring out our, you know, what lineups work, but I got great confidence in those guys.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe on rotation: Early in the season, we're playing with different combinations, different groups. I have great faith in our guys. We've had a lot of different contributions in different lineups.

structured.context: Brian Keefe discusses the ongoing process of experimenting with different lineups and rotations early in the season.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Keefe on opponent three-point shooting
quotes.excerpt: I want us taking efficient shots.
quotes.quote: I think our team is built to be playing the paint and play to our strength, scoring the rim, free throw attempts. I want us taking efficient shots. I think we took efficient shots tonight, we didn't make some of them. But everybody's got a different formula. We're figuring out what works best for us, and we think attacking the rim, getting to the rim, getting to the free throw line, establishing ourselves early, and I know that we're going to open up the court with our shooting, that's going to come.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe on offensive philosophy: I think our team is built to be playing the paint and play to our strength, scoring the rim, free throw attempts. I want us taking efficient shots.

structured.context: Brian Keefe outlines his philosophy on shot selection and the team's offensive identity.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on offensive struggles and defensive needs
quotes.excerpt: our offense has been lacking really to be honest all season.
quotes.quote: Obviously our offense, our defense wasn't good tonight either, but our offense has been lacking really to be honest all season. Our defense has been what's carried us, and once our offense gets going, I definitely see us being a better team. We definitely have to shoot more threes and get more threes up, but it still has to be quality looks and good looks.
quotes.social_post: Trae Young on the Wizards offense: Our offense has been lacking really to be honest all season. Our defense has been what's carried us, and once our offense gets going, I definitely see us being a better team.

quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on playing against the Hawks

Obviously, I played in front of our fans and they really gave us a lot of love to begin the game, and we just didn't give them enough reason to cheer loud the whole game.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on leadership and rebounding responsibilities
quotes.excerpt: I need to help my bigs rebound every time.
quotes.quote: I got to obviously there's times that I need to get down there and get boards and help my bigs rebound every time, especially when teams like we played tonight, they shoot a lot of threes and you shoot threes, they're long rebounds. A lot of those threes they shot tonight were long, they were tip-outs to them back again. So a lot of that is on the guards because the bigs are usually around the rim.
quotes.social_post: Trae Young on rebounding: I got to obviously there's times that I need to get down there and get boards and help my bigs rebound every time. A lot of that is on the guards because the bigs are usually around the rim.
